name: v123_netprofit_dispersion_lowcorr_trade
hypothesis: Annual net-profit estimate level with falling dispersion and rising coverage may capture broad profit visibility outside the occupied EPSR/PTP/FCF surfaces; the low market-correlation gate is meant to avoid old analyst-expectation sleeves.
expression: trade_when(correlation_last_60_days_spy < correlation_last_360_days_spy, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netprofit_mean / assets, 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netprofit_std / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netprofit_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20)), -1)

name: v123_netprofita_largecap_visibility
hypothesis: Adjusted net-profit attribution estimates are a cleaner profitability-expectation parent than EPSR; a large-cap gate should reduce sub-universe fragility and keep it away from small sparse analyst names.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.340 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netprofita_mean / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netprofita_std / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netprofita_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_90_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry) + 0.120 * rank(-(close / open - 1)), -1)

name: v123_annual_totassets_netprofit_restraint

name: v123_saf_revision_contrarian_eventful
hypothesis: The SAF detail vector has zero local alpha/user count and may represent a different forecast horizon; contrarian broad revisions under high absolute-return conditions test whether estimate upgrades are overextended without using EPSR/PTP/long-term estimate parents.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) > 0.55, 0.350 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_saf_v4_nd_estimate) - vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_saf_v4_nd_previosestimate)) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_saf_v4_nd_estimate) - vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_saf_v4_nd_previosestimate)) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_saf_v4_nd_estimate) / abs(assets), 63), 126), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20)), -1)

name: v123_fnd6_special_items_event_reversal
hypothesis: Prior FND6 special-item cleanliness was weak; the opposite structure tests whether large settlement/restructuring/fair-value shocks are over-penalized after eventful price moves.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) > 0.55, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_setaq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_rcaq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_tfvceq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.140 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)

expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.40, 0.270 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(derivative_liability_fair_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(notional_value_derivative_contracts) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(available_for_sale_securities_oci_adjustment) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(current_federal_tax_expense_amount / assets, 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 90), industry), -1)
